text: Hi everyone, my foreign license will expire on September 12th, which is also the day that I reach 5 years of driving experience. I'm on a B2 visa currently waiting to get a B1, we don't have a date yet but I am expecting it to be another couple of months. How would I go about converting my license without needing to retake the tests here? I arrived here less than a year ago so right now I'm still just driving on the foreign license.  Thank you!
